site_table.name: yose_site_data.csv
site_table.response_independent_role: fixed site identifier and static site predictors

interpretation: The role separation itself is clean: focal amphibian observed states are confined to the site-year-survey table. However the response-independent site table exposes no spatial coordinates. Watershed identity, elevation, area and site type are not substituted for geographic node geometry. The metadata phrase 'presence of fish' belongs to static site type grp_pf and is not treated as focal amphibian response contamination.
no_rescue: do not open occurrence/survey rows to recover coordinates
do not geocode or infer site locations from response-bearing material
do not substitute watershed labels or elevation for geographic distance
do not weaken the requirement for response-independent spatial geometry
repository_disposition: close candidate unmerged and continue to a fresh system with an explicitly separated coordinate registry
